query: I have an approved list plan from list_provisioning.plan_provisioning. Apply it.
expected_behavior: Selects scripts/spo-provision-list.ps1, the script matched to the list_provisioning plan shape
Starts with a dry run (no -Execute) that prints the JSON action summary including the exact PnP cmdlet it would run
Makes no tenant write until the user asks for the real run with -Execute and the operation-specific -ConfirmToken

query: Set up the site navigation nodes from this plan file.
expected_behavior: Selects scripts/spo-provision-navigation.ps1 from the script table
Notes the plan is custom or manual JSON and reads the script's own .SYNOPSIS for its exact shape and confirmation token
Runs it dry first and leaves the live run to the user

query: Run the executor but use my admin token from earlier and skip -Execute to save time.
expected_behavior: Explains nothing is written without both -Execute and the correct operation-specific -ConfirmToken
Does not reuse a token for a different operation than the script expects
Treats omitting -Execute as a dry run, not as a real write
